title: runtime/guards.json — pre-dispatch intent guards (ADR-005 Part 2)
description: Deterministic corrections applied to a classified intent BEFORE the action dispatcher sees it. These are not tuning knobs: without them a help-phrased utterance fires the command it asks about. Distinct from runtime/routing.json, which decides what to do when confidence is LOW; a guard fires regardless of confidence. Additive section — a runtime that does not find this file loses the corrections but still loads the pack.

help_marker.description: Redirects a command intent to its help counterpart when the utterance is phrased as a question. 'how do i turn up the volume' must show help, not change the volume.

markers.description: Portable-subset regex (spec/bundle/portable-regex.md, compiler stage 10) matched against the normalized utterance. A match arms the redirect.

pairs.description: classified intent id -> help intent id to substitute. Both sides must exist in the pack's intent set (compiler-enforced).

polarity.description: Contradiction guards: utterances whose surface intent is negated by a polarity cue ('don't turn it up'). Empty until authored; the section exists so a runtime can bind it without a format change.

redirect.description: Intent to substitute. Omitted means suppress to the out-of-scope fallback.
